## Why

On 2026-10-16 the outer session filed every item as `slicer add` with eight flags, then `slicer promote ID --file spec.md`. `import` already does both in one step from an outline whose key lines carry size, tree, findings, pass, scores, depends, `discovered_from` and `parent` (`src/slicer/outline.py:41`). Three gaps hid that path:
- the outline has no `short_title` key, which `add --short-title` sets;
- the skeleton's key list (`slicer import --skeleton`) leaves out `key`, `discovered_from` and `parent`;
- AGENTS.md and `slicer ai instructions` describe `add` then `promote` for one item and `import` only for several.
